description: This file provides utility functions for calculating costs associated with OpenAI models, including token-based and time-based costs, as well as video generation costs. It helps manage cost estimation for different call types and models within the larger application.

methods.name: Literal["cost_per_token","cost_per_second"] cost_router(call_type: CallTypes)
methods.description: Determines whether to use per-token or per-second cost based on call type.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_token( model: str, usage: Usage, service_tier: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Calculates the cost for a given model and usage, focused on token-based estimation.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_second( model: str, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str], duration: float = 0.0 )
methods.description: Calculates the cost based on duration and model for time-based estimation.

methods.name: float video_generation_cost( model: str, duration_seconds: float, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Estimates the cost of video generation based on model and duration.
